                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                        (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            comps.append((color, cells))

    # Find the long L-shaped color marker.
    for marker, cells in comps:
        if len(cells) < 5:
            continue
        rows = {}
        cols = {}
        for y, x in cells:
            rows.setdefault(y, set()).add(x)
            cols.setdefault(x, set()).add(y)
        horiz = [(y, min(xs), max(xs)) for y, xs in rows.items()
                 if len(xs) >= 3 and max(xs)-min(xs)+1 == len(xs)]
        vert = [(x, min(ys), max(ys)) for x, ys in cols.items()
                if len(ys) >= 3 and max(ys)-min(ys)+1 == len(ys)]
        corners = []
        for y, x0, x1 in horiz:
            for x, y0, y1 in vert:
                if (y, x) in cells and x0 <= x <= x1 and y0 <= y <= y1:
                    corners.append((y, x))
        if not corners:
            continue

        cy, cx = corners[0]
        # The object to recolor lies in the open quadrant of the L.
        left = any(x < cx for x in rows.get(cy, set()))
        right = any(x > cx for x in rows.get(cy, set()))
        up = any(y < cy for y in cols.get(cx, set()))
        down = any(y > cy for y in cols.get(cx, set()))
        qy = 1 if up and not down else -1
        qx = 1 if right and not left else -1

        choices = []
        for color, obj in comps:
            if color == marker:
                continue
            ys = [y for y, x in obj]
            xs = [x for y, x in obj]
            if (qy == 1 and min(ys) >= cy) or (qy == -1 and max(ys) <= cy):
                continue
            if (qx == 1 and min(xs) >= cx) or (qx == -1 and max(xs) <= cx):
                continue
            # distance to the corner, favoring the closest object in the quadrant
            d = min(abs(y-cy) + abs(x-cx) for y, x in obj)
            choices.append((d, color, obj))
        if choices:
            _, _, obj = min(choices, key=lambda z: z[0])
            for y, x in obj:
                out[y][x] = marker
        break
    return out

    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color, cells))

    # Identify an L-shaped guide consisting of a long horizontal and vertical
    # segment, then recolor the nearest object in its open quadrant.
    for color, cells in comps:
        S = set(cells)
        corners = []
        for y, x in cells:
            arms = []
            for dy, dx in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
                if (y+dy, x+dx) in S:
                    n = 0
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    while (yy,xx) in S:
                        n += 1
                        yy += dy
                        xx += dx
                    arms.append((dy,dx,n))
            horiz = [a for a in arms if a[0] == 0 and a[2] >= 2]
            vert = [a for a in arms if a[1] == 0 and a[2] >= 2]
            if horiz and vert:
                corners.append((y,x,horiz[0][1],vert[0][0]))
        if not corners:
            continue
        y, x, hx, vy = max(corners, key=lambda p: sum(1 for a,b in cells if abs(a-p[0])+abs(b-p[1]) > 0))
        # open quadrant points opposite the two guide arms
        qy, qx = -vy, -hx
        candidates = []
        for other, obj in comps:
            if other == color:
                continue
            ys = [a for a,b in obj]
            xs = [b for a,b in obj]
            if (min(ys) > y if qy > 0 else max(ys) < y) and (min(xs) > x if qx > 0 else max(xs) < x):
                d = min(abs(a-y)+abs(b-x) for a,b in obj)
                candidates.append((d, obj))
        if candidates:
            obj = min(candidates, key=lambda z:z[0])[1]
            for a,b in obj:
                out[a][b] = color
        break
    return out
